whoWeAre.subTitle: WHO WE ARE
whoWeAre.title: Engineered For Excellence, Committed To Earth
whoWeAre.description: Hewadwal is an Afghan solar energy company dedicated to providing efficient and sustainable renewable energy solutions. Since its foundation, the company has helped customers achieve greater energy independence through high-quality solar systems, battery solutions, and professional energy services. With a commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, Hewadwal continues to support Afghanistan's transition toward a cleaner and more sustainable energy future.

features.title: Quality Products
features.description: Certified and tested for maximum performance.

ourJourney.subTitle: OUR STORY
ourJourney.title: The Beginning Of Our Journey
ourJourney.description: Hewadwal began its journey in 2013 by supplying solar energy products to meet the growing demand for reliable electricity solutions in Afghanistan. In its early years, the company focused on providing solar panels, batteries, and power equipment for residential customers. As the demand for renewable energy increased, Hewadwal expanded its services to include commercial and industrial solar projects, helping businesses reduce energy costs and improve power reliability. Over the years, the company has successfully delivered numerous solar solutions, strengthened its technical expertise, and built lasting relationships with customers. Today, Hewadwal continues to grow by providing innovative and sustainable energy solutions across Afghanistan.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.description: Welcome to Safe Energy Solutions. We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of our customers, website visitors, and business partners. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information when you interact with our website, products, and services related to solar energy systems, batteries, and renewable energy solutions. By using our website or submitting your information, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
